A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Roasted Vegetables**:

**Ingredients:** Chicken thighs, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, potatoes, lemon, garlic, olive oil, herbs (thyme/rosemary), salt/pepper.

**Method:** Toss cubed potatoes with oil/salt, roast 15 min at 425°F. Push aside, add chicken (skin-side up) and broccoli, roast 20 min. Add tomatoes last 5 min. Squeeze lemon over everything, sprinkle fresh herbs.

**Time:** 10 min prep, 35 min cook, minimal cleanup.
